digest.component_or_area: MCP server ticket store push pipeline
propositions: MCP server writes commit locally to tickets branch but cannot push to origin/tickets, stranding events that gates cannot see while returning success to caller

Store recovery via fetch-merge-push race-loses under sustained high contention when origin receives competing pushes faster than recovery cycle completes, causing exponential backlog inflation of merge commits

Gate certification paths must assert store freshness before consulting attestations to prevent wrong verdicts from stale views, refusing with stale-store signal rather than certifying against diverged remote-tracking ref
Deployed MCP store exhibits ENV_ID_MISMATCH indicating re-clone without carrying git-ignored local state, causing op-cert attestations signed under foreign identities to fail verification
Backlog of 150+ merge commits with only 28 real events proves exhaustion of _MAX_RETRIES budget on every write, requiring reconciliation without event loss on append-only store
